status: post-opening spatial-transfer validation frozen before split-specific endpoint readback
ecological_question: Is species activation geometry reproducible across completely disjoint sets of NAAMP routes, rather than being driven by persistent route-specific composition or survey structure?

route_split.algorithm: SHA-256 UTF-8 hash of route_cluster; split A if first digest byte < 128, otherwise split B

data.matched_pair_rule: same frozen wetter-drier adjacent-observed-year pairing within State x RouteNumber x RunNumber
data.activation_geometry_definition: same opportunity-corrected wet-gain placement model as temporal repeatability analysis
data.informative_pair_rule: 0 < q_pair < 1, where q_pair is fraction of drier-run stops acoustically inactive

overlap_family.rule: species estimable in both disjoint route splits

primary_test.metric: Spearman rank correlation between split-A and split-B activation_geometry_log_odds

prespecified_sensitivities.weighted_regression: WLS split_B_geometry ~ split_A_geometry weighted by inverse split-B variance with HC3 covariance; expected positive slope
prespecified_sensitivities.sign_concordance: fraction retaining spatial-edge versus local-deepener sign; one-sided exact binomial test against 0.5

diagnostics: number of routes and informative pairs in each split
species-level gain counts, route counts and geometry CIs
interpretation_if_supported: Activation geometry transfers across non-overlapping route sets, strengthening its interpretation as a repeatable species response trait rather than a route-specific artifact.
interpretation_if_null: Do not generalize activation geometry beyond temporal repeatability within the observed route network.
boundaries: Disjoint-route validation is not independent-species replication.
Hash splitting tests transfer across route identities, not a specific east-west or climatic geographic gradient.
Activation geometry remains an acoustic gain-placement response trait, not dispersal, occupancy or colonization.
No alternative hash rule, eligibility threshold or geometry definition may replace the frozen specification after readback.
